info.name: Research Reproducibility Checker API
info.description: API smoke and contract tests. Set baseUrl to http://localhost:8000. Analyze calls invoke the live pipeline unless cached.

item.name: Analyze paper (live Groq call if not cached)

exec: pm.test('Response has paper and report', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('paper'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('report'); });

item.name: Reject non-PDF upload (select a non-PDF file)

exec: pm.test('Rejects unsupported file with 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
